name: PR Review Agent & Multi-Specialist Auditor
description: Multi-agent pull request reviewer inspecting security vulnerabilities, algorithmic logic, and code style in parallel with consensus voting and automated GitHub publishing.

agentProfile.name: PR Review Bot
agentProfile.description: Automated code review bot that coordinates specialist agents to audit PRs

nodes.prompt:
You are a Principal Application Security Auditor. Audit this PR for security vulnerabilities:
Repository: {{nodes.fetch_diff.output.repo}} (PR #{{nodes.fetch_diff.output.pr}})
Title: {{nodes.fetch_diff.output.title}}
Diff:
{{nodes.fetch_diff.output.diff}}

Perform a thorough security audit checking for:
1. OWASP Top 10 risks: Injection, broken access control, SSRF, XSS, insecure deserialization.
2. Leaked credentials, hardcoded secrets, API keys, or private tokens in code/config.
3. Unsafe dependencies, prototype pollution, or regex denial of service (ReDoS).

Return strictly valid JSON:
{
  "verdict": "approve" | "request_changes",
  "score": 0-100,
  "findings": ["<list of security findings or 'None identified'>"],
  "notes": "<detailed, specific security review analysis>"
}

You are a Principal Systems Architect & Logic Specialist. Audit the algorithmic correctness and system logic of this PR:
Repository: {{nodes.fetch_diff.output.repo}} (PR #{{nodes.fetch_diff.output.pr}})
Title: {{nodes.fetch_diff.output.title}}
Diff:
{{nodes.fetch_diff.output.diff}}

Analyze:
1. Algorithmic correctness and edge case handling (null/undefined inputs, empty collections, boundary values).
2. Concurrency hazards, race conditions, async/await error propagation, and unhandled promise rejections.
3. State mutations, idempotency, and potential resource leaks or infinite loops.

Return strictly valid JSON:
{
  "verdict": "approve" | "request_changes",
  "score": 0-100,
  "findings": ["<list of logic findings or 'None identified'>"],
  "notes": "<detailed, specific logic review analysis>"
}

You are a Staff Code Quality & Maintainability Specialist. Review the code quality and maintainability of this PR:
Repository: {{nodes.fetch_diff.output.repo}} (PR #{{nodes.fetch_diff.output.pr}})
Title: {{nodes.fetch_diff.output.title}}
Diff:
{{nodes.fetch_diff.output.diff}}

Review:
1. Clean Architecture: SOLID principles, separation of concerns, meaningful identifiers.
2. TypeScript strictness: strict types, avoiding unsafe 'any', proper return contracts.
3. Maintainability, self-documenting code, and clean refactoring standards.

Return strictly valid JSON:
{
  "verdict": "approve" | "request_changes",
  "score": 0-100,
  "findings": ["<list of style/quality findings or 'None identified'>"],
  "notes": "<detailed, specific code quality analysis>"
}

nodes.message: Review consensus reached: {{nodes.vote_collector.output.decision}}. Approve publishing review to GitHub?
